svg.title: Where errors are handled: a repository throws a low-level error, the service catches only what it can act on and wraps it with context, and a single central handler maps known errors to 4xx responses and logs unexpected ones as 500 with a request ID

svg.text: Catch where you can act; everything else flows to one central handler.
